title: Trailers: 11 commit(s) on main without a KB-Work trailer git reads
goal: kbgit.py check-trailers, the push gate, refuses each commit the trailers detector flags (a KB-Work line git does not read as a trailer, and a code change with no KB-Work and no KB-Auto trailer), so no such commit reaches origin/main and no commit of the last 7 days on origin/main is one.
notes: a KB-Work line git does not read as a trailer (a blank line before Co-Authored-By?): 178087d30b, 7219acbb56, 8da30157b3, 9cb820ecb3, ac03d1b3fa; changes _tools/, .claude/, .githooks/ or .gitlab-ci.yml with no KB-Work or KB-Auto trailer: 5c3bfd0ea7, 9286c5e81c, ad70d90965, b8c95fccdd, d7a88846d7, ffe1273a0c Gate gap (2026-10-06): python3 _tools/kbgit.py check-trailers 7219acbb56~1..7219acbb56 and ffe1273a0c~1..ffe1273a0c both print bad=0 (kb_commits=0), so the gate passes commits the detector flags; the flagged commits age out of the 7-day window by 2026-10-10, so the repro alone would pass with no fix. The added check runs the gate on 7219acbb56 (KB-Work in its own paragraph before Co-Authored-By) and passes once the gate refuses it.
